About Kinetosphere

Kinetosphere brings circuit building, provider programs, workout playback, and connected training libraries into one experience.
Current version: v6.10.32

Exercise & Health Disclaimer

Kinetosphere provides exercise and fitness information for general educational purposes only. It is not medical advice and is not a substitute for evaluation, diagnosis, or treatment by a qualified healthcare professional.

Exercise involves inherent risks, including the risk of injury. You are responsible for determining whether an exercise or program is appropriate for you, using suitable equipment and technique, and stopping if you experience pain, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or other concerning symptoms. Consult an appropriate healthcare professional before beginning or changing an exercise program if you have a medical condition, injury, are pregnant, or have other health concerns.

Content from independent providers reflects those providers’ guidance. Kinetosphere does not guarantee results or that any exercise, program, or provider content is suitable or safe for every person. By choosing to participate, you accept responsibility for your own exercise decisions and participation.

Interim legal language — to be reviewed by counsel before commercial launch.

YouTube Playlist Import

Your eight Movement Type playlists are preloaded below. A movement may belong to more than one Movement Type. Import also infers standardized Equipment and Muscle Group tags from each title and description.
The key is stored in this browser's IndexedDB. For a browser-based app, use a Google Cloud API key restricted to the YouTube Data API and, when you host the app, to your site's HTTP referrer.
Ready. Save your API key, then test one Movement Type before importing all eight.

Stack 52 Import

Ten Stack 52 playlists are preloaded. The reviewed classification file excludes workout/instruction videos and maps each exercise into the same Movement Type, Muscle Group, and Equipment schema used by OPEX.
Ready. This import is owner-only and skips the 14 reviewed non-exercise videos.

NASM / Edge App Import 222 Reviewed Exercises

Imports the reviewed NASM / Edge App provider library. Provider exercise names are preserved exactly after removal of the leading instructional phrase. Canonical mapping metadata is attached without overwriting provider names. Records whose original playable source could not be recovered remain searchable in the library but cannot be added to the circuit player until media is restored.
Ready. Owner-only. 160 records currently have recovered playable YouTube media; 62 remain reference-only until provider media is recovered.

CrossFit Import 83 Instructional Movements

Imports 83 selectable CrossFit movement-demonstration videos from the supplied playlist. CrossFit versions are intentionally retained even when the movement overlaps another source because the video itself contains instructional detail. Twenty-six technique/modification videos and sixteen non-exercise videos were reviewed separately and are not added as standalone exercise cards in this first pass.
Ready. Owner-only. Difficulty is intentionally left unnormalized until the planned global Easy / Medium / Hard audit.

Movement Journey Import 101 Canonical Exercises

Imports the reviewed Movement Journey canonical exercise library into the existing shared exercise table. The 101 canonical movements now include their hosted Cloudflare Stream teaching assets while preserving original YouTube source IDs and clip boundaries. Programs and flows are available from the Programs / Flows tab, including their 32 hosted introductions and prescribed movement order.
Ready. Owner-only. Existing Movement Journey records with the same canonical IDs will be updated.
